title: Boy in Overalls on Horse, Sister with Reins - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century outdoor snapshot capturing a young boy in striped shirt and overalls sitting in a western-style saddle on a calm horse, making an animated expression at the camera. Standing beside the horse and holding the reins is an older sister or young companion dressed in dark trousers and a collared shirt. They are positioned along a sunny roadside near foliage and utility poles. The reverse of the photo is blank with black paper remnants at the corners from removal from a vintage scrapbook album.
